description: Move the overnight rota sync job off the old cron script into an async job queue so large multi-site rota pushes don't tie up the scheduling server.

description: Push overnight handover notes to each site's shared inbox via the same async job queue used by the rota sync pipeline.

title: Rota sync v2 fails to push overnight handover changes for site 7
description: Site 7 front desk reports overnight handover notes are not syncing - the push job appears to silently fail for that site's inbox only. Rollout check (MED-410) only covered sites 1 through 6 and did not catch this. Root cause looks like a stale mailbox id left over from site 7's move to the new building. PR up: #217.
